Name: Kenneth's Midnight Snack
Author: Kf29
Description:
[b][size=4]Kenneth's Midnight Snack[/size][/b]

[size=4][b]Gives your farmer a midnight snack, for those nights you are still awake late.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]I made this because sometimes I stay up late in game to fish, and I like the idea of having a small snack at midnight.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It is a different snack each day, usually something light like chips, cookies, or ice cream with a soda. 28 different snacks in total, one for each day of the month, and it loops when the next month starts.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Midnight snack is available from 12am to 1:59am. Go outside during that time and it will be in your bag. If you sleep early or miss it, you wait for the next day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]If your bag is full, check the lost and found at the mayor's house.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works on new or existing saves. Sleep one night after installing and it will start.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You will need Kenneth's Restaurant, Drink Shop, and Grocery Store, plus SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Safe to add or remove anytime.[/b][/size]
